publications.title: MOVA: Towards Scalable and Synchronized Video–Audio Generation
publications.description: MOVA (MOSS Video and Audio) is an open-source video and audio generation model that aims to achieve high-quality, synchronized video and audio content generation. The model is based on a 32B parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture and activates 18B parameters during inference, supporting IT2VA (Image to Video Audio) and T2VA (Text to Video Audio) tasks. It can generate naturally synchronized lip-synced speech, environment-aware audio effects, and content-aligned background music. The project provides a complete toolchain for efficient inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and prompt enhancement.

publications.title: MOSS Transcribe Diarize: Accurate Transcription with Speaker Diarization
publications.description: This paper introduces a multi-modal large language model MOSS Transcribe Diarize, which can perform transcription, speaker diarization, and timestamp output simultaneously. Compared to the traditional method of separating speech recognition and speaker diarization, this model can process long conversations (about 90 minutes) in a single model and maintain speaker consistency on multiple evaluation sets, outperforming existing commercial systems.

publications.title: MOSS-Speech: Towards True Speech-to-Speech Models Without Text Guidance
publications.description: Our method combines a modality-based layer splitting architecture with a frozen pre-training strategy, leveraging the inference and knowledge capabilities of pre-trained text large language models while extending the native speech processing capabilities. Experimental results show that the model achieves the best performance on speech question-answering tasks and remains competitive in speech-to-speech generation tasks compared to text-guided systems.

publications.title: MOSS-TTSD: Text to Spoken Dialogue Generation
publications.description: MOSS-TTSD is a bilingual dialogue speech synthesis model (Text to Spoken Dialogue) that can directly generate natural and expressive speech from multi-speaker dialogue text. The model is based on the Qwen3-1.7B-base architecture and trained on massive single-speaker and dialogue speech data to achieve bilingual support, long text speech generation, and zero-shot dual-speaker speech cloning capabilities, suitable for high-quality speech synthesis in podcast, interview, intelligent interaction, and other dialogue scenarios.

publications.title: SpeechGPT 2.0 - Preview Version
publications.description: SpeechGPT 2.0-preview is the first anthropomorphic real-time interactive system we launched towards contextual intelligence. As an end-to-end speech large model trained on millions of hours of voice data, it features anthropomorphic spoken expression and sub-100ms low-latency response, supporting natural and fluent real-time interruption interaction.

publications.title: VLABench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Robotics Manipulation with Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
publications.authors: Shiduo Zhang, Zhe Xu, Peiju Liu, Xiaopeng Yu, Yuan Li, Qinghui Gao, Zhaoye Fei, Zhangyue Yin, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang & Xipeng Qiu
publications.description: "First benchmark for VLA. Not only for evaluation, definition matters most."

publications.title: LongSafety: Enhance Safety for Long-Context LLMs
publications.authors: Mianqiu Huang, Xiaoran Liu, Shaojun Zhou, Mozhi Zhang, Chenkun Tan, Pengyu Wang, Qipeng Guo, Zhe Xu, Linyang Li, Zhikai Lei, Linlin Li, Qun Liu, Yaqian Zhou, Xipeng Qiu, Xuanjing Huang
publications.description: This paper introduces LongSafety, a specialized safety alignment dataset for long-context LLMs (spanning 8 tasks, ~17K samples, ~40.9K tokens average) along with a benchmark LongSafetyBench, and shows that fine-tuning on it improves safety in long contexts without degrading general capabilities.

publications.title: DetectiveQA: Evaluating Long-Context Reasoning on Detective Novels
publications.authors: Zhe Xu, Jiasheng Ye, Xiaoran Liu, Xiangyang Liu, Tianxiang Sun, Zhigeng Liu, Qipeng Guo, Linlin Li, Qun Liu, Xuanjing Huang, Xipeng Qiu
publications.description: DetectiveQA is a narrative reasoning benchmark based on detective novels with very long contexts (on average over 100,000 tokens), offering 1,200 Chinese-English question-answer pairs with detailed reasoning chains, designed to test LLMs’ abilities in long-text comprehension, evidence retrieval, and reasoning, and demonstrating that current long-context LLMs still struggle significantly with dependency questions that truly require full context.
